at.help: Experience (or merit) at which the rank starts (rising).

badge.help: 0 to 3 characters shown on the unit.

description.help: A short line shown in the launcher.

saving.help: any: Continue save and five slots; continue: only the automatic save; off: nothing is saved (docs/SAVES.md).

battleScene.help: How fights are shown: quick on the map, or in the side-view battle scene (docs/BATTLE_SCENE.md).

battleBackgroundFrom.help: Whose square picks the battle scene's background and platform.

battlePlatformFrom.help: same: both fighters on one platform; own: each on the platform of its own square.

battleSceneSides.help: Which side of the scene each fighter stands on.

battleSceneStaves.help: A staff used on one other unit plays in the scene.

menuUnavailable.help: An action with nothing to act on stays greyed in the menu, or is left out.

attackWeaponChoice.help: Attack goes straight to the targets, or first asks which weapon to use.

grid.help: Hexagon games (docs/HEX.md); without this block the game is square.

view.help: Logical screen size the game is drawn at.

tileSize.help: Size of a square in logical pixels.

font.help: Text font; without it the built-in pixel font is used.

name.help: A built-in font: pixel, pixel-ttf, arcade, sans, serif or mono.

file.help: Your own .ttf / .otf inside the game folder (instead of name).

smooth.help: true: anti-aliased at full screen resolution; false: hard pixel edges.

stats.help: The game's own stats (at least one); units, weapons and formulas use them.

roles.help: Which stats the engine itself needs.

resources.help: Resources of the game (funds, action points ...); a resource may refill each turn.

refill.help: At the start of the side's turn the amount becomes min(left over, carryOver) + perTurn.

carryOver.help: Most of the old amount that survives into the next turn.

unitResources.help: Pools each unit has for itself (MP and the like; at most 4) that abilities spend. Ids unique and not a resources id.

max.help: The stat that is the pool's maximum.

start.help: Percent of the maximum at the start of a battle.

regen.help: Refilled at the start of each of the unit's turns.

moveTypes.help: How units move over terrain (at least one); terrain and structures price each.

sounds.help: Step sounds of this move type (docs/SOUND.md).

stepInterval.help: Seconds between two steps of a walk (0.02 to 2).

switches.help: Story switches (off / on) that map events and the campaign read and set (docs/EVENTS.md).

scripts.help: Lua files loaded in order, e.g. scripts/formulas.lua.

maps.help: The battles of the game, in order.

id.help: Unique id; campaigns and events name it.

formulas.help: The damage formulas (a = attacker, b = defender, w = weapon; docs/GAME_FORMAT.md).

damage.help: Damage of a hit, e.g. a.str + w.might - b.def.

hit.help: Hit chance in percent; absent = always hits.

critMultiplier.help: Damage multiplier of a critical hit.

damageTypes.help: The game's own damage types (at most 16). Without this key a game has none. First one is the default of a weapon.

id.help: Unique id; weapons name it in damageType, units key resist{} by it.

ignoresTerrain.help: Terrain defence bonuses do not count against this type.

resistRange.help: [min, max] allowed for every resist value; must include 0 and needs damageTypes.

difficulties.help: The maker's own difficulties (docs/DIFFICULTY.md); without it the game has none.

change.help: Whether the player may change it later.

styles.help: Switchable looks (docs/GAME_FORMAT.md Visual styles); the first is the default.

view.help: Kind of view: 2D, 2D isometric, 3D isometric, full 3D (docs/VIEWS.md).

showGlyphs.help: Show the terrain letters (default: the style's own).

largeArt.help: This style's art needs a lot of memory; small consoles do not offer it.

tileWidth.help: Even number, width of a diamond.

tileHeight.help: Even number, height of a diamond (not on hexagon games).

heightStep.help: Pixels one level of height lifts a square.

unitWidth.help: Width a unit sprite is drawn at.

rules.help: Game rules. Optional blocks have an Enable switch; a game without the block plays as before.

counterAttacks.help: A defender answers an attack when it can.

defeat.help: What loses a battle for a side (default: noUnits).

hitRoll.help: single: one roll; average2: the average of two rolls.

turnOrder.help: Who acts when: sides take turns (default), or units act one at a time by speed (docs/TURN_ORDER.md).

mode.help: speed: units act by their speed stat.

stat.help: Stat that fills the clock (default: a stat named speed).

threshold.help: Clock value at which a unit may act.

preview.help: Turns shown in the order preview.

ctCost.help: Clock cost of a finished turn by what the unit did (each at least 1).

builtUnitsCanAct.help: A unit built this turn may already act.

amount.help: Formula: capture points a unit takes off per turn.

items.help: Items and inventories (docs/ITEMS.md); a game has items when data/items.json lists some.

weapons.help: fixed: weapons come with the unit type; carried: weapons are items.

storage.help: Where the shared item storage can be reached.

sellPercent.help: Share of an item's price a buying shop pays.

freeBattleStorage.help: What the shared storage holds in a free battle (docs/ITEMS.md).

uses.help: Uses left (at most the item's own uses; not for unlimited items).

structures.help: Own structures also refill fuel and ammunition.

repair.help: Units on an own structure heal.

amount.help: Percent of maximum HP per turn.

costShare.help: Percent of the proportional unit cost paid (default 100).

needsStructure.help: Research needs an owned structure with research: true.

cancelRefundPercent.help: Share of the cost paid back when research is cancelled.

fog.help: Fog of war options (maps switch fog on).

ambush.help: A unit that walks into a hidden enemy: its turn ends, or it may still act.

enemyRanges.help: false switches the enemy-range display off for this game.

needs.hint: needs a resource: add one under resources

actionPoints.help: One shared pool per side pays for walking and attacking (docs/SRPG.md Action points).

splitMoves.help: A unit may walk in several parts.

softCap.help: Movement points that cost the plain price.

cost.help: Points per attack (a weapon's apCost overrides).

attacksPerTurn.help: Attacks one unit may make per turn.

height.help: Height rules: jumping, range bonus, line of sight (docs/SRPG.md Height rules).

jump.help: Level differences a unit may climb or drop while walking.

default.help: Game default: one number, or separate up and down.

flyingMoveTypes.help: Move types that ignore height differences.

perLevels.help: Levels of height for one extra square.

facing.help: Units face a direction; hits from behind are stronger (docs/SRPG.md Facing).

arcs.help: Names the forecast shows for each arc.

progression.help: Experience and levels, or (with levels) a rank table that replaces levelling.

xpPerLevel.help: Experience for one level (not with a rank table).

maxLevel.help: Highest level (not with a rank table).

xpNoDamage.help: Experience for a fight that did no damage: a number, or a formula (a = the unit, b = its foe).

levels.help: Rank table that replaces levels (excludes xpPerLevel / maxLevel).

ranks.help: Merit ranks on their own counter, beside levelling (not with progression.levels).

name.help: Name of the counter, 1 to 16 characters.

abilityPoints.help: Ability points earned by units whose equipment teaches (items' teaches); refused when no item teaches.

name.help: Short word shown to players, 1 to 8 characters.

perBattle.help: Points each unit gets when its side wins.

perAction.help: Points at every moment experience is awarded.

perDefeat.help: Extra points for defeating a unit of another side.

jobs.help: Job system rules; the jobs are in data/jobs.json (docs/JOBS.md).

share.help: Percent of every JP gain that allies in the same job also get.

spendJp.help: false: learn entries are learned only from equipment (no cost on them; each must be taught by some item).

slots.help: Learned abilities a unit may carry, per slot.

jpLevels.help: JP totals of the job levels, rising.

rescue.help: Units carry or pair up with allies (docs/SRPG.md Rescue and pair up).

mode.help: carry: pick an ally up; pairUp: stand together.

canCarry.help: Formula: may unit a carry unit b?

carrierStats.help: How the carried unit changes the carrier's stats (not the hit points stat).

pairBonus.help: Stat bonus of a pair (not the hit points stat).

classSkills.help: Does the new class keep or replace the old class's skills?

testAt.help: The level at which the test level promotes a unit that can promote (docs/DIFFICULTY.md Test level). Missing: it never promotes.

testPromotedTag.help: A unit type with this tag also counts as already promoted for the test level (needs testAt). Missing: only classes that another class promotes into.

places.help: Doors, chests and visitable places (docs/SRPG.md section 10).

actions.help: menu: Open / Visit in the unit's menu; auto: happens when a unit ends its move there.

turnOrder.help: best: the single best action of any unit first; order: one unit at a time by its behaviour order.

weights.help: Named attack weight sets a unit's behaviour picks ("weights": "classic").
